consequence.statement: New read-only CLI commands for ArtifactGenerator are added; nothing is stated to break or change for existing operators.

original.statement: Flux CLI 2.7.0 adds read-only commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind.

decision.reason: [ev-707cfb9a39bd] lists this in the CLI changelog only as an addition of read-only commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind. Nothing in it says that anything existing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or changes. An environment that does nothing simply doesn't use the new commands, so "none" (informational) is correct.
